verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at https://www.inngest.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with Inngest-specific content). Cited pages also show agent-oriented docs: a /docs-markdown/ tree of machine-readable pages and a dedicated AI dev tools section for coding agents. The /docs.md path returns 404, but the /docs-markdown/ variants cover the same need. Missing for 10: independent or community confirmation that pointing agents at these docs works well in practice, and evidence of a full-content variant such as llms-full.txt.
